name: Maharani Bagh Orchard Retreat - Juba & Badla
why_it_matters: WelcomHeritage-run 19th-century mango orchard owned by the Jodhpur royal family — 200 bigha estate with 16 cottages, twin multi-cuisine restaurants Juba and Badla in a Rajasthani village-courtyard layout, plus Machaan, the BBQ outpost. Sits between Jodhpur and Udaipur as the conventional Ranakpur stay.
insider_tip: Lunch under the mango trees in season (March-May) is the property's photograph — book a courtyard table not the indoor hall, and ask if Machaan is firing that evening before deciding between BBQ and the multi-cuisine Juba menu.
signature_address: WelcomHeritage Maharani Bagh Orchard Retreat, near Sadri Railway Station, Ranakpur, Pali District, Rajasthan 306702

name: Aranyawas Resort Restaurant
why_it_matters: Aravalli-set resort with an in-house dairy and organic vegetable farm — the kitchen plates from its own produce, which is a rare claim outside the high-end heritage circuit. TripAdvisor 3.8, ranked #8 of 18 in Ranakpur.
insider_tip: The pool deck has the better Aravalli view than the indoor restaurant — ask to be seated outside if the weather permits.
signature_address: Aranyawas Resort, Ranakpur, Pali District, Rajasthan 306702
